title: Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission (National Policing Information Charges) Bill 2026
short_title: Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission (National Policing Information Charges) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would provide a replacement legal basis for the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission to charge taxes on applications for nationally coordinated criminal history checks.
The minister would set charge amounts and covered services through legislative instruments, considering recommendations from the National Policing Information Committee when determining amounts.
The bill would operate with the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission Bill 2026, commencing only when that companion bill commences and extending to external territories.
changes: Applications for prescribed criminal history checking services would attract a charge imposed as a tax.
The minister could set different rates for service types and applicant groups, including zero charges.
State property would be protected from taxation under the charging provisions.
summary.affected: Criminal history check applicants and accredited checking organisations are affected.
